name: Resolution
overview: Scripture teaches that resolution involves both the wise handling of conflict and the faithful pursuit of godly intentions. Proverbs 15:1 and Matthew 18:15 emphasize gentle communication and personal reconciliation as keys to resolving disputes, while Romans 12:17 and Ephesians 4:26 instruct believers to avoid retaliation and manage anger righteously. Jeremiah 29:11 reminds us that God's plans for peace and hope undergird our resolutions, encouraging us to align our commitments with His purposes.
